title: Nexus CoreWorkspaceCommitRequest
description: Workspace session commit request. Wire field spelling is camelCase, preserved from the existing workspace.commit surface. The changes manifest is validated against the session snapshot (OCC).

sessionId.description: Session id returned by workspace open; must not be empty.

changes.description: Manifest of changes to commit, each with path, op, optional pre-image hash and optional base64 content.

expectedHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the pre-image; omitted for create.

contentBase64.description: Canonical base64 content for create/modify; forbidden for delete.
